title: Ptolemy's Geography: the 6,372 coordinates of the catalogue (books 2-7) and the modern positions of 56 identified towns

sources.cite: G. Graßhoff & O. Defaux, Catalog of Ptolemy's Geography, main books (Humboldt University Berlin / Max Planck Institute for the History of Science, 2019), after A. Stückelberger & G. Graßhoff, Klaudios Ptolemaios, Handbuch der Geographie (Schwabe, Basel, 2006); CC BY 4.0
Wikidata, coordinate location (P625) of the modern site of each identified town, CC0; the identifications are those of the catalogue (column Modern_location)

units.lonP: Ptolemy's longitude, degrees east of the Fortunate Isles (his prime meridian); Omega recension, Xi where Omega gives none
units.lat: modern latitude of the site, degrees N positive (Wikidata P625, rounded to 0.001)
units.lon: modern longitude of the site, degrees E positive (Wikidata P625, rounded to 0.001)

inputs.origin: Graßhoff & Defaux, Catalog of Ptolemy's Geography (Zenodo 3585758).
inputs.caveats: Five cells typed with truncated decimals (37.33333) move by less than a minute.

inputs.origin: Made once with Wikidata's API (wbgetentities by English Wikipedia title) for 56 towns identified by the catalogue.
inputs.caveats: Panticapaeum left out (no coordinates under that title).

notes: History, not evidence: the map tab carries no badge. Coordinates are rounded to 1/12 degree (5 minutes), Ptolemy's own finest step; five catalogue cells typed with truncated decimals (37.33333) move by less than a minute. modern.csv was made once with Wikidata's API (wbgetentities by English Wikipedia title) for 56 towns whose identification the catalogue gives and the literature does not dispute; Panticapaeum was left out (no coordinates under that title).
